_comment: Initial values of the regional HBV head: medians over the 602 gauged CAMELS-GB catchments of a per-catchment HBV-9 calibration (NSE on 1989-2008; 10 000 Latin-hypercube parameter sets, best set per catchment, then gradient refinement from the 4 best sets). Used for GB, US and AUS alike. Values are float64 reprs.
